$comment: Site-only copy keyed by owned theme slug. Not a registry pack: colors, name, mode, radius, font, and shadow live only in the theme files beside this directory.

contrast.character: Maximum-contrast dark theme: pure black surfaces, white text, and a yellow primary that cannot be missed.
contrast.use: Accessibility-first setups, sunlight, or projector demos where every boundary must shout.

ember-dusk.character: Warm charcoal with burnt-orange action colors; embers over a dark hearth.
ember-dusk.use: Long evening sessions where a dark theme should feel warm rather than clinical.

graphite.character: Square-cornered neutral dark with a pale primary and a single teal focus note.
graphite.use: Screenshots and docs where the components should read without a palette talking over them.

midnight-violet.character: Deep indigo surfaces with violet action colors and soft lavender focus.
midnight-violet.use: A saturated dark look that keeps prose contrast high.

nord-frost.character: Cool arctic blues on slate; muted aurora status colors.
nord-frost.use: Readers who find pure black harsh and want a familiar low-chroma dark palette.

paper-light.character: Warm paper neutrals with a deep teal primary; quiet and editorial.
paper-light.use: Documentation and reading-heavy surfaces in daylight.

solstice.character: Cream and apricot light theme with a burnt-orange primary.
solstice.use: A warm light default that still keeps status colors unmistakable.

pocket-voltage.character: Saturated royal blue with an electric yellow primary and small red signal notes; crisp, energetic, tight corners.
pocket-voltage.use: Dashboards and demos that should feel quick and playful without losing legibility.

mako-reactor.character: Near-black bottle green and steel with a luminous green primary; dense, industrial, square.
mako-reactor.use: Terminal-adjacent tooling where fine borders and glow accents carry the hierarchy.

silver-key-sky.character: High-key sky blue over pearl white with cool silver borders; airy, optimistic, very round.
silver-key-sky.use: Consumer-facing light surfaces that should feel light-filled rather than flat white.

neon-pilgrim.character: Ink black with a hot magenta primary and cyan reflections; restrained amber for warnings.
neon-pilgrim.use: Night-mode products that want neon character without gradient noise.

spice-horizon.character: Sand and parchment fields with burnt-spice action colors and a rare deep blue focus ring; shadowless.
spice-horizon.use: Warm, dry light theme where borders and value steps do the separating.

moon-prism.character: Pearl and rose with midnight-navy text, lavender accents, and fine gold in charts; generously round.
moon-prism.use: Soft light surfaces that stay high-contrast where it counts.

vector-grid.character: Blue-black canvas with luminous cyan and one ultraviolet accent; geometric, technical, shadowless.
vector-grid.use: Data-dense dark tooling with precise one-pixel boundaries.

forest-spirit.character: Rice paper, moss, and sage with a single vermilion focus note; organic roundness.
forest-spirit.use: Calm light theme for long reading and review sessions.

blood-moon-cathedral.character: Wine-black surfaces, oxblood action colors, bone text, and aged gold focus.
blood-moon-cathedral.use: A dramatic dark look that keeps danger and primary reds separable by more than hue.

sunday-panel.character: Warm newsprint with cobalt actions, a yellow highlight surface, and bold outlines; flat and square.
sunday-panel.use: Print-flavored light surfaces with strong edges and no gradient softness.
